Espresso Dial-In Log — DF64 Gen 2 Grinder with SSP Cast Sweet Burrs:
- Bean: Ethiopia Guji Uraga washed light roast (roasted August 14 by Sey).
- Grind setting: 14.5 on the stepless collar.
- Dose: 18.0 grams in IMS precision 18g basket with 0.85mm puck screen.
- Yield: 45.0 grams liquid out (1:2.5 ratio) at 93C boiler temperature and 8.5 bar flat pressure.
- Shot time: 27 seconds total (including 5 seconds pre-infusion at 3 bar).
- Tasting notes: Bergamot, white peach, crisp jasmine tea finish. No astringency.
